text:
alice: Heads up — last 3 backup uploads to s3://rwd-snapshots went lacking SSE headers, observed 3 objects with no x-amz-server-side-encryption. Possibly related to yesterday's RBAC prune. :rotating_light:

ben-sre: @alice can you paste the object head? also pinging @carol-sec

alice: here's head-object for one key:
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket rwd-snapshots --key tenant42/2026-03-21/part-0001
{
  "ContentLength": 12543000,
  "ETag": "\"abc123\"",
  "LastModified": "2026-03-21T14:10:12.000Z"
}
```
No "ServerSideEncryption" field.

carol-sec: ugh. Did the backup-uploader role lose kms:Encrypt? who's the principal now?

ben-sre: checking deploy logs: 
```
kubectl -n backups logs deploy/backup-uploader | grep "SSE"
2026-03-21T14:09:52 INFO starting multipart upload, sse header not present
```

mike-backup-eng: we rolled a change yesterday to remove a stale serviceAccountBinding in iam-policy; maybe the role mapping fell back to the node instance role which doesn't have kms access.

drew-oncall: @mike-backup-eng can you confirm which IAM principal the pod assumes now? paste the sa token mapping.

mike-backup-eng: `kubectl get sa backup-uploader -o yaml` shows `serviceAccountName: backup-uploader` but our IAM role annotation was accidentally deleted in the helm chart change. The node IAM has s3:PutObject but no kms:* permissions.

carol-sec: that lines up. So objects got uploaded with no SSE-C or SSE-KMS header. Is the bucket policy enforcing SSE? I thought we had a bucket-level denial.

alice: bucket policy has condition requiring `x-amz-server-side-encryption` for PutObject, but that rule is on `rwd-snapshots-prod` — these were tenant-specific staging prefix in `rwd-snapshots`, policy exempted staging. Bad config.

ben-sre: TL;DR: RBAC change removed the pod's IRSA annotation -> uploader used node role -> node role allows PutObject without SSE -> bucket policy allowed staging prefix -> objects uploaded unencrypted.

carol-sec: Action items:
1) Revoke access to unencrypted objects (restrict read/list) :lock:
2) Rotate credentials / reattach correct IRSA annotation before next upload.
3) Run scan to find other objects missing SSE headers.
4) Add an audit alert for head-object returns missing ServerSideEncryption.

drew-oncall: I'll run a quick scan now: `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket rwd-snapshots --prefix tenant42/2026-03-21/ --query 'Contents[].Key'` then head-object each.

backup-bot: Scan job queued: s3-unencrypted-scan-1851240100. Results will post in #eng-security when done.

mike-backup-eng: rolling hotfix: re-add IRSA annotation to backup-uploader helm values and redeploy. ETA 12m.

alice: also need to check CloudTrail: I don't see PutObject events for the time window — audit logs show PutObject from instance-role but there's a suppression rule for autoscaling-managed instances. We must update audit svc.

auditsvc: flagged gap: CloudTrail trail `infra-trail` had `ExcludeManagementEvents: true` for that ASG role; created ticket CT-432 to re-enable data events for that bucket.

carol-sec: good. After hotfix, we should re-upload snapshots encrypted under CMK and put objects in quarantine + rotate tenant keys if needed. Also document the RBAC reviewer step for helm PRs.

ben-sre: assigning follow-ups: @mike-backup-eng (fix IRSA + redeploy), @drew-oncall (scan + quarantine list), @auditsvc (enable data events). I'll own post-incident writeup.

mike-backup-eng: redeployed, backup-uploader pod now annotated with `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/backup-uploader-role` — logs show sse headers now included.

alice: confirmed head-object shows `"ServerSideEncryption": "aws:kms"` and `"SSEKMSKeyId": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/aaa-bbb-ccc"` for new uploads. :white_check_mark:

carol-sec: let's run a one-time reencrypt job for the 3 unencrypted objects and then rotate the CMK for tenant42 as precaution. Schedule in ticket.

ben-sre: closing loop: postmortem ticket SEC-890 created. Keep thread for audit copy.

drew-oncall: FYI we found 7 more stale PRs that touched helm values removing annotations. adding to backlog.

alice: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
end
